snippet.title: VWisher - A VTuber gacha game with no ads or microtransactions
snippet.description:
After a long time in development, VWisher is ready for release. Wish for 8 different VTubers with more to come in this non-profit game. Collect, level and explore with the VTubers you've collected and discover new VTubers you may have missed. Play on SplameiPlay on 14th February 2026

-- Releasing soon --
